name: Fill Holes
description: Closes open holes in the active piece with new triangles and leaves the existing surface where it is. A patch can get its own face group. Reports progress and can be stopped.

params.label: Largest hole (edges)
params.help: Openings with more boundary edges than this are left open, so a missing back doesn't get a cap by accident.

params.label: New group for each patch
params.help: Each filled hole gets the next free face group, so the patch is easy to mask, hide or paint.

params.text: Existing vertices, mask, color, groups and hidden faces stay. Only the holes gain triangles. Subdivision levels are cleared; Undo brings them back.
